ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast (~85:15 ratio); predominant high-intensity (white) central surface area bounded by low-intensity (black) terminal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black perimeter along the entire trailing edge and lateral tips. A central low-intensity vertical formation extends from the peduncle junction through the median notch. Two distinct, isolated low-intensity circular blobs are located at coordinates roughly 15% from the left lateral margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 65 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of ~1:10 relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations observed along the entire boundary; pixel amplitude is greatest (5-10 pixels) on the distal thirds of both lobes, appearing as sharp peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trajectory is convex from the notch to mid-lobe, with a secondary concave inflection leading to the attenuated lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of two localized, high-contrast dark circular pixel clusters on the left lobe's mid-lateral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, non-parallel linear grey-scale disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white high-intensity fields of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and ragged contouring on the extreme upper-left lateral tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine, vertical low-intensity pixel 'streaks' or 'feathering' patterns bleeding from the trailing edge border into the white ventral field.
